cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('compiler.py').read()
start = src.index('def analyze_cuts(')
end = src.index('# ------------------------------------------------------------- plan builder')
new = '''def analyze_cuts(links, env, period, parts, slack_limit=64):
    """Find separating cuts S with small slack (participants P = S & C).

    Returns list of tuples (S_set, P_set, slack_out, slack_in) where
      slack_out = crossing - sum(r_v, v in P) >= 0,
      slack_in  = crossing - sum(r_v, v not in P) >= 0
    for feasible instances.  Pairwise-forced min-cuts recover every tight cut.
    """
    n = 0
    for (u, v, c) in links:
        n = max(n, u + 1, v + 1)
    for v in parts:
        n = max(n, v + 1)
    D = sum(parts.values())
    sigma, tau = n, n + 1
    total_cap = sum(period * env.get(idx, 0) for idx in range(len(links)))
    INF = D + total_cap + 1
    participants = sorted(parts)
    Cset = set(participants)
    pos = [v for v in participants if parts[v] > 0]
    found = {}

    def record(S):
        P = S & Cset
        if not P or P == Cset:
            return
        crossing = sum(period * env.get(i, 0)
                       for i, (u, v, c) in enumerate(links) if (u in S) != (v in S))
        d1 = sum(parts[v] for v in P)
        d2 = sum(parts[v] for v in Cset - P)
        so = crossing - d1
        si = crossing - d2
        if so < 0 or si < 0:
            return
        key = frozenset(P)
        val = (S, P, so, si)
        if key not in found or (so + si) < (found[key][2] + found[key][3]):
            found[key] = val

    # out-form: value = crossing + sum(r, v not in S) = slack_out + D
    for u in pos:
        for w in participants:
            if u == w:
                continue
            g = Dinic(n + 2)
            for idx, (a, b, c) in enumerate(links):
                cp = period * env.get(idx, 0)
                if cp > 0:
                    g.add(a, b, cp)
                    g.add(b, a, cp)
            for v in participants:
                if parts[v] > 0:
                    g.add(sigma, v, parts[v])
            g.add(sigma, u, INF)
            g.add(w, tau, INF)
            val = g.maxflow(sigma, tau)
            if val - D > slack_limit:
                continue
            S = g.source_side(sigma)
            if u in S and w not in S:
                record(S)
    # in-form: value = crossing + sum(r, v in S) = slack_in + D
    for u in participants:
        for w in pos:
            if u == w:
                continue
            g = Dinic(n + 2)
            for idx, (a, b, c) in enumerate(links):
                cp = period * env.get(idx, 0)
                if cp > 0:
                    g.add(a, b, cp)
                    g.add(b, a, cp)
            for v in participants:
                if parts[v] > 0:
                    g.add(v, tau, parts[v])
            g.add(sigma, u, INF)
            g.add(w, tau, INF)
            val = g.maxflow(sigma, tau)
            if val - D > slack_limit:
                continue
            S = g.source_side(sigma)
            if u in S and w not in S:
                record(S)
    out = []
    for (S, P, so, si) in found.values():
        if min(so, si) > slack_limit:
            continue
        out.append((S, P, so, si))
    out.sort(key=lambda t: (t[2] + t[3]))
    return out


'''
src = src[:start] + new + src[end:]
open('compiler.py','w').write(src)
print('rewritten analyze_cuts')
